title: Zürich HB — Abfahrt
brief: A live departures board for Zürich main station: 14 fictional but plausible trains (IC, IR, S-Bahn) with platform, delay, and destination. A giant Swiss railway clock (SVG, red second hand that pauses at 12 for ~2 s like the real Mondaine).
aesthetic: Swiss International Style, 1960s Josef Müller-Brockmann: obsessive grid, flush-left, asymmetric, no ornament.
palette: SBB red #EB0000, pure black #000, white #FFF, cool grey #D9DDE2
layout: Strict 12-column grid; oversized clock top-left spanning 4 columns; board rows aligned to baseline grid; hairline rules only.
signature: Real-time ticking clock; minute countdown per train; rows re-sort as trains depart; a train that leaves slides out.

title: Bauhaus Ausstellung 1923
brief: An exhibition poster page announcing a fictional centenary Bauhaus retrospective: dates, venue, program of lectures, and a manifesto excerpt on form and function.
aesthetic: Bauhaus / Herbert Bayer: primary geometric shapes, lowercase-only typography, diagonal composition.
palette: Bauhaus red #D02A1F, yellow #F2C40E, blue #1B4FA7, black #111, warm off-white #F4F1EA
layout: Single-viewport poster on desktop (content fits in one screen), then a compact program list below; circle-triangle-square dominate.
signature: The three primitive shapes reassemble into different compositions as the user scrolls (scroll-driven transforms); lowercase-only text.
avoid: Any photo, any texture, any serif.

title: A Manifesto for Slow Software
brief: A polemic essay in 12 numbered theses arguing for software that respects attention, with an epilogue and a reading list.
aesthetic: Web brutalism: raw, default-looking HTML made deliberate — visible borders, system fonts, huge scale, no decoration.
palette: White #FFF, black #000, default link blue #0000EE, visited purple #551A8B — used intentionally and at massive scale

fonts.display: Times New Roman (system stack, no webfont)

layout: One enormous column; theses numbered in 120px+ type; a CSS-only marquee headline; tables with visible borders.
signature: Hovering any thesis inverts the whole page (black on white becomes white on black) via a body class; a scrolling marquee of counter-arguments.
avoid: Webfonts, rounded corners, shadows, colors beyond the four.

title: Snack Cartel
brief: Landing page for a fictional subscription of weird international snacks: hero, 6 snack cards with absurd tasting notes, pricing table, FAQ.
aesthetic: Neo-brutalism: thick 3px black outlines, hard offset shadows, clashing flat colors, sticker shapes.
palette: Lime #C6FF00, black #000, violet #7B61FF, hot yellow #FFD60A, white #FFF
layout: Chunky card grid with overlapping stickers; oversized buttons; sections separated by thick rules.
signature: Buttons physically depress (shadow collapses) on press; stickers wobble on hover; a rotating 'AS SEEN NOWHERE' badge.

title: Memphis Milano 1981
brief: A tribute to the Memphis design group: a short history, 6 iconic pieces described (Carlton bookcase, Tahiti lamp, etc.) as cards, and a timeline.
aesthetic: Memphis Design: terrazzo, squiggles, confetti, black-and-white bacterio pattern, clashing pastels.
palette: Pastel pink #F6B8D0, teal #2EC4B6, banana yellow #FFE45E, black #111, cream #FFF8F0
layout: Asymmetric cards rotated a few degrees; a terrazzo background band; squiggles as section dividers.
signature: Squiggles and confetti shapes drift with mouse parallax; the bacterio pattern is a repeating SVG data URI.

title: The Meridian Hotel, 1928
brief: A landing page for a fictional Art Deco grand hotel: welcome, three suites, the cocktail bar menu, and a reservation card.
aesthetic: Art Deco: sunbursts, stepped forms, gold foil on black, symmetric elegance.
layout: Perfectly centered symmetric composition; sunburst hero; stepped section frames.
signature: SVG sunburst rays rotate imperceptibly slowly; gold text uses a moving gradient via background-clip:text like light on foil.

title: Absinthe Verte — A Botanical
brief: An illustrated guide to the botanicals in absinthe (wormwood, anise, fennel, hyssop, melissa) with history and a ritual for the louche.
aesthetic: Art Nouveau / Alphonse Mucha: whiplash curves, organic frames, muted naturals.
palette: Absinthe green #7BA05B, mustard #D6A419, terracotta #B0593A, ivory #F5EFDF, ink #2B2A28
layout: Decorative SVG frame around the hero; botanicals in a curved, flowing arrangement not a rigid grid.
signature: Vine tendrils draw themselves (stroke-dashoffset) as sections enter the viewport; the louche animation clouds a glass on click.

title: Workers' Radio Hour
brief: A program schedule for a fictional 1920s revolutionary radio station: 8 broadcasts with times, presenters, and short blurbs; a call-to-listen.
aesthetic: Russian Constructivism / Rodchenko: diagonals, photomontage-like blocks, bold sans, red and black.
layout: Everything set on a 12° diagonal; blocks collide; huge exclamation-like shapes; radio tower as geometric SVG.
signature: Scroll-driven: text blocks slide along the diagonal at different speeds; a loudspeaker SVG emits expanding rings.

title: Mondrian Machine
brief: An interactive composition generator: press space or click to make a new De Stijl-style grid, with a short essay on Neoplasticism and the rules the generator follows.
aesthetic: De Stijl: primary colors, black bars, white, rectilinear only.
layout: Full-viewport generated canvas with a slim rules panel; essay below in a strict rectilinear grid.
signature: Randomized CSS-grid composition animates between states (grid-template transitions); keyboard shortcut; copy palette button.

title: M A L L ✦ 1995
brief: A nostalgic dreamscape about a dead shopping mall: floor directory of vanished stores, a food court poem, and 'now playing' Muzak titles.
aesthetic: Vaporwave: perspective grid floor, Greek bust silhouettes, glitch, Japanese katakana accents, Windows-era chrome.
layout: Horizon-line hero with infinite scrolling grid floor; directory as glowing floating panels.
signature: Animated perspective grid (CSS 3D, moving toward the viewer); text glitch/chromatic aberration on hover; slow sun-disc with horizontal bands.

title: AquaOS 7
brief: Marketing page for a fictional early-2000s operating system: glossy feature bubbles (Aqua Dock, Bubble Browser), system requirements, and a download button.
aesthetic: Frutiger Aero / early Y2K optimism: glossy bubbles, lens flares, water and grass, translucent plastic.
palette: Sky blue #3AA0FF, grass green #6BD425, white gloss, deep water #0A4D8C
layout: Centered hero with a glossy window mockup; feature bubbles float; wave divider.
signature: Floating glossy bubbles rise (CSS radial-gradient spheres with specular highlight); glass buttons with a moving sheen.

title: NEON DISTRICT // access node
brief: A fictional cyberpunk hacker terminal: system status, a 'jobs board' of 6 illicit contracts, and a decrypting message from a fixer.
aesthetic: Cyberpunk HUD: scanlines, corner brackets, acid yellow on black, magenta warnings.
palette: Black #050505, acid yellow #F6FF00, magenta #FF2A6D, cyan #05D9E8, grey #8A8F98
layout: Dense HUD panels with bracketed corners; left status rail; main log window.
signature: Text decode/scramble effect that resolves characters one by one; CRT scanline overlay; blinking status LEDs; glitch on hover.

title: Verdant Commons Co-op
brief: A community energy & garden cooperative site: how the solar share works, this season's harvest, upcoming workdays, and membership.
aesthetic: Solarpunk: warm organic greens and golds, Art-Nouveau-meets-tech optimism, hand-drawn leaves and sun arcs.
palette: Leaf #4F8A3C, sun gold #F5B82E, terracotta #C9623A, sky #BFE3F0, cream #FBF6EA
layout: Rounded organic sections with leaf-shaped SVG dividers; hero with sun arcs over a rooftop garden (SVG).
signature: Day/night slider changes the hero scene (sun position, sky gradient, lit windows) and the solar output figures.

title: Grandmother's Bread
brief: A hand-written recipe card for a rustic country loaf: ingredients, method steps with checkboxes, notes in the margin, and a story about who taught it.
aesthetic: Cottagecore: cream paper, sage, dusty rose, doodles, gingham trim.
layout: A single recipe card centered on a gingham tablecloth; margin notes rotated slightly.
signature: Servings slider rescales every ingredient quantity live; step checkboxes strike through; a doodled wheat border.

title: Reading List — Winter Term
brief: A scholar's annotated reading list of 10 (real, public-domain) books with marginalia, a syllabus grid by week, and a note on candlelight.
aesthetic: Dark academia: oak, oxblood, brass, parchment, candlelight.
layout: Book-like two-column with a margin column for handwritten-style notes; drop caps.
signature: A candle flicker: a warm radial light follows the cursor with subtle flicker animation, illuminating text near it.

title: Zine Fest 2026
brief: Event page for a zine fair: exhibitors list (16 fictional zines with one-line descriptions), schedule, venue, and how to table.
aesthetic: Risograph print: two fluorescent inks overprinted, misregistration, paper grain, halftone.
palette: Fluorescent pink #FF48B0, riso blue #0078BF, paper #F7F3EC; overprint makes purple
layout: Overlapping ink layers; big rotated headline; exhibitor list as a two-color table.
signature: mix-blend-mode:multiply overlaps; SVG feTurbulence grain overlay; a slow 1–2px misregistration drift between the two ink layers.
avoid: Smooth gradients, more than 2 inks + paper.

title: June & Theo — Letterpress
brief: A wedding invitation suite: the invitation, ceremony details, RSVP card, and a map note — all as letterpress pieces on cotton paper.
aesthetic: Letterpress stationery: blind deboss, one ink color, cotton paper texture, restraint.
palette: Cotton white #F7F4EE, navy ink #1E2A44, blush edge #E8C9C0
layout: Stacked cards centered with generous margins; each card has edge painting (colored border).
signature: Deboss effect via layered inset text-shadow; paper texture via SVG noise; RSVP card flips over in 3D to reveal the reply form.

title: Bicycle — Technical Drawing
brief: A blueprint of a classic randonneur bicycle with numbered callouts (frame geometry, gearing, brakes) and a spec table.
aesthetic: Cyanotype blueprint: white/cyan lines on Prussian blue, drafting lettering, dimension arrows.
layout: Large SVG drawing centered with a title block in the bottom-right corner like a real drawing sheet.
signature: The bicycle draws itself line by line (stroke-dashoffset sequence); hovering a callout number highlights the part and shows its dimension.

title: The Keepers of Light
brief: A magazine long-read about lighthouse keepers: 5 sections, pull quotes, a sidebar on Fresnel lenses, and an illustrated lighthouse header.
aesthetic: High-end editorial magazine: asymmetric columns, drop caps, pull quotes, generous white, one accent.
layout: Asymmetric 8/4 grid; pull quotes break the grid; sidebar boxed with a hairline.
signature: SVG lighthouse whose beam sweeps in a slow rotation and lights up the headline as it passes; drop caps.

title: The Daily Ledger — Extra Edition
brief: A full broadsheet front page: masthead, 6 fictional news stories in dense columns, a weather box, stock table, and classifieds.
aesthetic: 1930s broadsheet newspaper: newsprint, 6 columns, justified text, vertical rules, blackletter masthead.
layout: 6-column CSS multi-column body; headline hierarchy with decks; rules between columns.
signature: Dateline shows today's real date; a 'stop press' ticker; the 'EXTRA' stamp rotates in on load; hover a story to raise it like lifting the paper.

title: RIOT SPINE #3
brief: A punk fanzine issue: a rant editorial, 3 band interviews (fictional), a gig list, and a letters page — all cut-and-paste.
aesthetic: Photocopied cut-and-paste zine: torn edges, tape, typewriter, marker, halftone.
layout: Blocks pasted at slight rotations; clip-path torn edges; tape strips across corners.
signature: Halftone dot pattern via CSS; blocks 'lift' on hover; a stapled-spine shadow down the middle.

title: Kintsugi — 金継ぎ
brief: A meditation on kintsugi, the art of repairing pottery with gold: philosophy of imperfection, the process in 5 steps, and three repaired vessels described.
aesthetic: Japanese wabi-sabi minimalism: vast whitespace, vertical text, one gold accent.
layout: Vertical writing-mode column on the right for Japanese; wide margins; one vessel silhouette per section.
signature: Gold crack lines (SVG paths) glimmer with a moving gradient as they enter view; vessels assemble from shards on scroll.

title: The Great Wave — An Appreciation
brief: An appreciation of Hokusai's Great Wave: composition analysis, the Prussian blue pigment story, and the 36 Views series context.
aesthetic: Ukiyo-e woodblock: flat layered color, bokashi gradients, cartouche and red seal.
layout: Layered SVG wave scene as hero; text in a vertical cartouche; red seal stamp.
signature: Parallax layered waves (SVG paths) move at different rates on scroll; a woodgrain texture via SVG filter.

title: Hygge Lighting Co.
brief: A product page for three Scandinavian lamps: each with materials, dimensions, and price; a story about darkness in winter.
aesthetic: Scandinavian minimalism: birch, wool, white, muted blue, honest materials.
layout: Airy product grid with lots of negative space; each lamp is an SVG illustration.
signature: A dimmer slider warms the page: the lamps glow (SVG radial light), the background dims, text tone shifts.

title: Palm Springs Modernism Week
brief: A festival program for a mid-century architecture festival: house tours, lectures, a cocktail hour, and a map of 6 iconic homes (fictionalized).
aesthetic: Mid-century modern: atomic starbursts, boomerangs, butterfly roofs, kidney shapes.
palette: Mustard #D9A404, avocado #7E8C3A, burnt orange #C75B2A, teal #2B7A78, walnut #5C3B24, cream #F7EEDD
layout: Tilted kidney-shaped panels; a starburst clock; program in a stepped grid.
signature: Starburst SVGs spin slowly; hover tilts cards in 3D like breeze-blocks catching light.

title: Fillmore Auditorium — Winter of Love
brief: A psychedelic concert poster for three fictional bands over a weekend, with liquid lettering and a set-times list.
aesthetic: 1960s psychedelic poster / Wes Wilson: warped melting type, vibrating complementary colors, swirling forms.
palette: Hot orange #FF5E1A, magenta #E0218A, lime #9AE419, deep purple #4B0F6B
layout: Poster-first: a single tall composition; text warped along SVG paths; set list in a swirl.
signature: SVG feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap animated so the type appears to melt and breathe; colors vibrate on hover.
avoid: Grids, legibility over vibe (but keep the set list readable).

title: DEAD PIXELS — Live at the Basement
brief: A punk gig flyer for a fictional band: ransom-note headline, three support acts, door time, price, and a rules list.
aesthetic: Punk flyer / Jamie Reid: ransom-note lettering, xerox grain, safety-pin yellow, torn paper.

fonts.display: Anton (mixed with Rock Salt and Special Elite per letter)

layout: One-sheet flyer; each headline letter is its own cut-out with different font/rotation/background.
signature: Letters shake on hover; xerox grain overlay; the flyer is 'stapled' to a wall (subtle background) and flaps slightly.

title: htop for your life
brief: A terminal 'process monitor' that lists life processes (sleep, coffee, worry, laundry) with CPU%, MEM%, uptime; a footer help bar; a load-average of the week.
aesthetic: ncurses TUI: box-drawing characters, phosphor green/amber on black, inverse-video selection.
palette: Black #0A0A0A, phosphor green #33FF66, amber #FFB000, dim grey #556
layout: Three panes with box-drawing borders; header meters as bracketed bars; F-key footer bar.
signature: Values update every second; j/k or arrow keys move the highlight; blinking block cursor; 'F9 kill' removes a process with a fade.
avoid: Any proportional font, any rounded UI.

title: System 6 Desktop
brief: A working 1-bit Macintosh desktop: menu bar with dropdowns, three draggable windows (About, Notepad, Puzzle), desktop icons, and a trash.
aesthetic: Classic Mac 1-bit: pure black and white, dithered patterns, pixel fonts, striped title bars.
palette: Black #000, white #FFF only (dither patterns for grey)
layout: Fixed desktop metaphor; windows overlap; menu bar fixed top.
signature: Draggable windows with z-order; menus open on click; dithered desktop pattern via CSS; image-rendering pixelated.

title: Solitaire Deluxe — Setup
brief: A Windows 95-style installation wizard for a fictional game: 5 steps (welcome, license, folder, progress, finish) with working navigation.
aesthetic: Windows 95: teal desktop, grey bevels, 1px inset/outset borders, MS Sans Serif.
palette: Teal #008080, grey #C0C0C0, navy title #000080, white #FFF, dark grey #808080
layout: Centered dialog window on desktop; sidebar image area; bottom button row.
signature: Bevel borders via border-color tricks; segmented progress bar animates; a Start button and taskbar with a working clock.

title: Pocket Monsters of the Garden
brief: A handheld-console page: a playable mini game (catch 10 garden bugs before time runs out) framed in a Game Boy shell, with a bestiary of 6 bugs.
aesthetic: Game Boy DMG: 4-shade green palette, 160×144 pixel canvas, chunky shell.
palette: #0F380F, #306230, #8BAC0F, #9BBC0F (only these on screen), shell grey #C4BEBB, magenta button #A0148C
layout: Console shell centered; screen is a canvas scaled with pixelated rendering; bestiary below as a pixel grid.
signature: Playable game on canvas at 160×144 internal resolution; D-pad and A/B buttons work (click and keyboard).
avoid: Any color outside the 4 shades on the screen.

title: CEEFAX P100 — Headlines
brief: A teletext service: page 100 index, headlines page, weather page, and TV listings; page numbers cycle automatically.
aesthetic: BBC Ceefax teletext: black background, saturated RGBCMY, block-mosaic graphics, double-height text.
palette: Black #000, teletext red #F00, green #0F0, yellow #FF0, cyan #0FF, magenta #F0F, blue #00F, white #FFF
layout: Fixed 40×25 character grid; header row with page number and clock; mosaic graphics via CSS grid blocks.
signature: Pages auto-rotate every 8 s with a page-number counter spinning; live clock in the header; mosaic weather map.

title: Field Notebook
brief: A naturalist's leather notebook: a cover with elastic band, and 4 pages of field notes about a week of birdwatching (sketches as SVG).
aesthetic: Skeuomorphic: leather grain, stitching, cream paper, brass corners, real-feeling shadows.
palette: Leather brown #5A3A22, cream #F4EBD3, brass #B8925A, pencil grey #4A4A4A
layout: A 3D notebook centered; pages turn.
signature: 3D page-turn (CSS perspective) with shadow; elastic band snaps open on click; leather texture via gradients + SVG noise.

title: Weather over Reykjavík
brief: A weather dashboard for Reykjavík (fictional forecast): current conditions, 24-hour strip, 7-day cards, and an aurora forecast.
aesthetic: Glassmorphism done well — the ONLY glass page in the set: frosted cards over a slow aurora sky.
palette: Aurora green #46F2B4, violet #7A5CFF, night #071226, frost white rgba(255,255,255,.12)
layout: Hero current-conditions card; scrolling hour strip; 7-day grid.
signature: Canvas aurora ribbons animating behind backdrop-filter cards; the 'now' card breathes with a slow glow.
avoid: Overusing blur — text must stay crisp.

title: Blob & Co. Toy Shop
brief: A toy shop landing page: 6 squishy toys with names/prices, a shop story, and a newsletter box.
aesthetic: Claymorphism: soft 3D clay, pastel, inner + outer shadows, rounded everything.
palette: Lavender #C8B6FF, peach #FFCDB2, mint #B8F2E6, cream #FFF8F0, plum text #3B2A4A
layout: Clay cards in a friendly grid; blob shapes as section backgrounds (border-radius morphing).
signature: Cards squish on hover (scale + shadow shift); blob backgrounds morph (border-radius animation).

title: Soft Synth — Control Panel
brief: A neumorphic synthesizer front panel: oscillator, filter, envelope knobs and sliders that actually control a WebAudio oscillator; a keyboard strip.
aesthetic: Neumorphism: monochrome extruded soft UI, light source top-left.
layout: Panel sections with extruded knobs; keyboard strip at the bottom.
signature: Working rotary knobs (drag) driving WebAudio (waveform, cutoff, attack/release); notes play on click; power button starts audio context.

title: Layers of the Forest
brief: An explainer of forest strata (emergent, canopy, understory, floor) with the species found at each; a depth meter.
aesthetic: Paper cut-out diorama: layered paper silhouettes with soft drop shadows, tactile depth.
palette: Deep green #1F5A3A, mid #3F8A5A, light #8FCB8F, sky #DCEFF5, paper #FDFBF5
layout: Full-height layered SVG silhouettes; text panels sit on paper cards between layers.
signature: Parallax: each paper layer moves at a different rate on scroll; shadows deepen with layer depth.

title: Isometric City Builder
brief: A click-to-build isometric city: choose building types, place on a grid, watch a day/night cycle; a stats panel (population, parks).
aesthetic: Isometric pastel city: CSS 3D cubes, soft shadows, tiny details.
palette: Pastel blue #A7C7E7, coral #F4A896, mint #B5EAD7, yellow #FDE68A, ground #F7F3EE
layout: Isometric grid fills the viewport; toolbar left; stats right.
signature: CSS 3D isometric tiles; click places buildings with a pop animation; day/night cycle shifts light.
avoid: Canvas — build it from CSS transforms.

title: Low-Poly Mountain Range
brief: A generative low-poly landscape: click to regenerate; controls for elevation, sun angle, and haze; a short note on triangulation.
aesthetic: Low-poly 3D illustration: faceted triangles, sunset gradient sky.
palette: Sunset coral #FF7B54, peach #FFB26B, dusk purple #5D3A9B, snow #F3F7FA
layout: Full-bleed SVG landscape; floating control card.
signature: SVG triangulated terrain regenerated from noise; faceted shading computed from sun angle; sky gradient animates.

title: Pixel Aquarium
brief: A pixel-art aquarium with 5 fish species, bubbles, and swaying kelp; click to drop food that fish chase; a species guide.
aesthetic: Pixel art: crisp pixels, limited bright palette on deep ocean.
palette: Ocean navy #0B1E3F, teal #1B6F8A, sand #E5C07B, fish orange #FF8C42, fish yellow #FFD23F, white #FFF
layout: Tank fills the viewport; guide strip below.
signature: Canvas at low internal resolution scaled up with image-rendering: pixelated; fish AI (wander, chase food).

title: ASCII Weather Station
brief: A weather station rendered entirely in ASCII: animated rain/snow/sun, a rotating ASCII torus 'radar', temperature graph in block characters.
aesthetic: ASCII art: monospace amber on dark, everything drawn with characters.
layout: Panels made of ASCII borders; a large pre for the animation.
signature: Real-time ASCII animation in a <pre> (rain falling, spinning donut torus via z-buffer math); mode switch buttons.

title: Rose Window
brief: A cathedral rose window study: the geometry of a 12-petal rose, symbolism of colors, and a hover-to-illuminate window.
aesthetic: Stained glass: jewel tones on black lead lines, light passing through.
layout: Huge SVG rose window centered; text arcs and columns around it.
signature: Light passes through: an animated gradient sweeps across glass panes; hovering a pane brightens it and shows its meaning.

title: Ravenna — Tesserae
brief: An essay on Byzantine mosaics of Ravenna with a live mosaic canvas that renders your typed word into gold tesserae.
aesthetic: Byzantine mosaic: gold, lapis, terracotta tesserae with grout lines.
layout: Canvas mosaic hero; essay in a single column with mosaic borders.
signature: Canvas renders text/shapes as irregular tesserae with grout and gold shimmer; mouse ripples through the tiles.

title: Major Arcana Reader
brief: A three-card tarot reading: shuffle, draw, flip; each card has an original SVG emblem and a short interpretation (past/present/future).
aesthetic: Occult / tarot: black, gold, midnight blue, stars, fine line ornament.
layout: Deck center; three card slots; interpretation panel below.
signature: 3D card flip; shuffle animation; star field twinkle; gold line ornaments.

title: The Book of Hours
brief: A page from an illuminated manuscript: a large illuminated initial, a canonical hours schedule, and a note on gold leaf and ultramarine.
aesthetic: Medieval illuminated manuscript: vellum, gold leaf, ultramarine, vermilion, vine borders, blackletter.
layout: Two-column manuscript page with a border of vines; a giant initial occupying 6 lines.
signature: Gold leaf shimmer animation on the initial and borders; vine border draws in; rubrication in red.

title: Grand Theatre — Tonight!
brief: A Victorian playbill: a variety night with 8 acts (fictional), prices by seat, and rules of the house — in stacked wood type.
aesthetic: Victorian wood-type playbill: many typefaces stacked, ornaments, curved text, borders.

fonts.display: Rye, Ultra, Sancreek, Alfa Slab One (stacked, one per line)

layout: Single centered column, each line a different width/typeface; ornamental rules between acts.
signature: Velvet curtain (CSS) parts on load to reveal the bill; text on SVG curves for the arched lines.

title: WANTED — The Timezone Bandit
brief: A Wild West wanted poster for a villain who steals hours from time zones: description, crimes, reward, and a sheriff's note.

palette: Parchment #E9D8B4, burnt edge #7A4B1E, ink #2A1E14, reward red #9B2226
layout: Single poster with a nailed corner; centered stack.
signature: Clicking the poster leaves bullet holes (SVG with splinters); the reward counter ticks up; aged paper via filters.

title: Terminal B — Departures
brief: An airport split-flap departures board: 16 flights with airline, destination, gate, status; statuses change over time.

layout: Full-width board rows; each character is its own flap cell.
signature: Split-flap animation per character (CSS 3D half-flaps) cycling through letters to the target; clacking rhythm via subtle stagger; statuses flip.

title: Halcyon City Metro

layout: Map SVG dominates; legend panel; line guide below.
signature: Lines draw in on load; animated train dots travel along paths (offset-path); hover a station to see connections.

title: Contour — Mt. Cinder

layout: Full-bleed canvas map; legend and profile in a bottom sheet.
signature: Canvas marching-squares contours from noise; hover shows elevation; slow drift of clouds' shadows; route animates.

title: Chart 1207 — Solvix Sound

title: Tonight's Sky

layout: Full-viewport canvas; overlay list panel; compass ring at the bottom.
signature: Canvas star dome with drag rotation and twinkle; constellation lines fade in when hovering a name.

title: Herbarium Sheet No. 47
brief: A pressed-plant herbarium sheet of a fictional wildflower with specimen label, collector notes, and hover-annotated parts.
